section.title: Prompts
section.description: Publish an agent or squad prompt as a versioned asset, and install prompts published by other workspaces.

list.empty_description: Try a different search term, or clear the filter to see everything published.
list.installed_empty_description: Install a prompt from the market. Installing adds it to this workspace and changes no agent or squad until you apply it.
list.member_note: Only workspace owners and admins can install prompts from the market.

detail.title: {{name}}
detail.companions_note: Listed by the publisher for context. Nothing here is installed with the prompt.
detail.withdrawn_note: This version has been withdrawn. It can no longer be installed or applied; workspaces that already applied it keep their text.
detail.load_failed: This prompt could not be loaded.

install.title: Install {{name}}
install.description: Installing adds this prompt to the workspace library. It writes to no agent and no squad — applying it is a separate, confirmed step.
install.already_installed_toast: “{{name}}” is already installed at this version

apply.title: Apply {{name}}
apply.no_targets_description: An agent prompt can only be applied to an agent, and a squad prompt only to a squad.
apply.cross_kind_note: Only {{kind}} targets are listed. A prompt cannot be applied across kinds.
apply.conflict_warning: This target already has prompt content. Keeping it is the default; overwriting has to be chosen.
apply.strategy_preserve: Keep local content, do not write
apply.diff_truncated: These prompts are too long to compare line by line, so the whole text is shown as replaced.
apply.identical: The target already holds exactly this text. Applying would change nothing.
apply.drift_description: The target's prompt changed after this preview was taken, so the comparison you are looking at is out of date.
apply.failed_note: The target's content is unchanged — nothing was partially written.
apply.done_description: “{{name}}” v{{version}} is now the prompt on this target.

publish.title: Publish this prompt
publish.content_note: A published version is a snapshot of this prompt as it is now. Later local edits do not change it — publishing a new version does.
publish.name: Display name
publish.companions_note: Only the prompt text travels. Skills, MCP servers, environment variables, and model preferences are not part of the asset.
publish.publisher_note: Your global display name is recorded with the version when you publish. The source workspace is never shown.
publish.required_note: Display name, summary, and license are required.
publish.scan_pass_description: Scanner revision {{revision}}. A scanner only catches patterns it knows — read the prompt yourself before making it public.
publish.scan_blocked_description: Edit the prompt at the source, refresh the snapshot, and check again. There is no way to publish past this.
publish.scan_truncated: The prompt was longer than the scanner reads, so the list below may be incomplete.
publish.visibility_private: Private draft (only you can see it; publish later)
publish.public_warning: Once public, members of all workspaces can search for, view, and install this prompt.

withdraw.title: Withdraw v{{version}}?
withdraw.description: It stops being visible to workspaces that have not installed it, and no one can install or apply it again. Workspaces that already applied it keep their text, and their update badge disappears. Withdrawal is final.

restore.title: Restore the previous prompt?
restore.description: This puts back the text the target had before the market prompt was applied. One step only — there is no further history.
restore.denied_toast: This prompt was edited after it was applied, so the restore stopped. Handle the edit by hand, or apply from the market again.

status_strip.applied_edited: “{{name}}” v{{version}} was applied, then edited here
status_strip.not_restorable: The one-step restore is no longer available for this prompt.
status_strip.draft_pending: You have an unfinished publish draft
status_strip.unsaved_note: Save this prompt before publishing — a published version snapshots the saved text, not what is on screen.
status_strip.source_changed: This prompt has changed since v{{version}} was published.

errors.unavailable: The prompt market is not enabled on this server.
